flow: Generate with AI → Evaluation Context → Generate and Evaluate
purpose: Exercise automatic adjustment toward easier-to-detect phishing with a lookalike sender and link.

generation_context.organization_context: Windropolis employees use a central SSO portal for internal services.
generation_context.sender_context: The message appears to come from the internal IT Service Desk.
generation_context.additional_instructions: Keep the scenario plausible but allow obvious phishing cues.

evaluation_context.situation_context: There is no current organization-wide password expiration campaign.

steps: Fill the generation fields from case.json.
Select Windropolis | IT Lookalike in Evaluation Context.
Set Prior training to Significant, Link usage to Used, and No attachments.
Enter the simulated URL and expected domain.
Run Generate and Evaluate and inspect automatic revision status.
expected_invariants: Lookalike sender/domain cue can be detected.
Lookalike link/domain cue can be detected.
Automatic adjustment may perform one or more accepted revisions.
Revised email does not contain meta-disclosure such as 'phishing simulation' or 'do not click'.
Revised HTML does not invent a new hardcoded http/https action URL; {{.URL}} is preserved when used.
